headline: 9 Solana program IDs catalogued from official Meteora docs and GitHub; Dynamic Vault program (24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi) confirmed as primary vault layer; audit PDFs gated behind Google sign-in.

findings.text: D1: Solana is not an EVM chain; canonical block explorers (Etherscan family) do not apply. No name-tag search on Solana explorers (e.g. Solscan, explorer.solana.com) was performed as those are not in the supported explorer list for DeFiPunkd's read API. Recorded in unknowns as D1-offchain.

D2: Official deployments page found at https://docs.meteora.ag/get-started/pushing-the-boundaries-of-defi listing all active and legacy program IDs. Active programs: DLMM (LBUZKhRxPF3XUpBCjp4YzTKgLccjZhTSDM9YuVaPwxo), DAMM v2 (cpamdpZCGKUy5JxQXB4dcpGPiikHawvSWAd6mEn1sGG), DBC (dbcij3LWUppWqq96dh6gJWwBifmcGfLSB5D4DuSMaqN), Presale Vault (presSVxnf9UU8jMxhgSMqaRwNiT36qeBdNeTRKjTdbj), Alpha Vault (vaU6kP7iNEGkbmPkLmZfGwiGxd4Mob24QQCie5R9kd2), Dynamic Fee Sharing (dfsdo2UqvwfN8DuUVrMRNfQe11VaiNoKcMqLHVvDPzh), Zap (zapvX9M3uf5pvy4wRPAbQgdQsM1xmuiFnkfHKPvwMiz). Legacy programs: DAMM v1 (Eo7WjKq67rjJQSZxS6z3YkapzY3eMj6Xy8X5EQVn5UaB), Dynamic Vault (24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi), Stake2Earn (FEESngU3neckdwib9X3KWqdL7Mjmqk9XNp3uh5JbP4KP), Farm (FarmuwXPWXvefWUeqFAa5w6rifLkq5X6E8bimYvrhCB1), Mercurial Stable Swap (MERLuDFBMmsHnsBPZw2sDQZHvXFMwp8EdjudcU2HKky).

D3: Two audit links provided in protocol.audit_links. Both Google Drive PDF links require Google sign-in and returned only a login page — content could not be extracted. Audit titles visible from og:title metadata: (1) 'Mercurial Finance - Final Report.pdf' and (2) 'Mercurial_Finance_Vault_Dynamic_AMM_Solana_Program_Security_Audit.pdf'. No in-scope addresses could be extracted. Recorded in unknowns as D3.

D4: GitHub repo https://github.com/MeteoraAg/vault-sdk fetched (redirected from https://github.com/mercurial-finance/vault-sdk). README confirms vault program ID 24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi. Repo structure includes programs/vault, ts-client, rust-client. No Foundry broadcast or hardhat-deploy artifacts visible at top-level. Separate mercurial-vault repo referenced in docs but URL not in allowlist this run. No pinned commit SHA available from fetch (branch 'main' only); commit SHA omitted per rules.
D5: Protocol operates exclusively on Solana (single chain). No multi-chain enumeration required.

D6: Dynamic Vault program (24Uqj9JCLxUeoC3hGfh5W3s9FM9uCHDS2SG3LYwBpyTi) is a factory/program that creates individual vault instances per token. DeFiPunkd read API does not support Solana (chainId not in supported list: 1,10,56,130,137,324,8453,42161,43114,59144,81457,534352,11155111). Factory child enumeration via read API is not possible for Solana. Recorded in unknowns as D6-offchain.

D7: Role taxonomy applied: Dynamic Vault program = vault (primary scope); Affiliate vault program = other (affiliate fee routing); VAULT_BASE_KEY = other (PDA seed constant, not an authority address); Treasury = treasury (fee recipient); DAMM v1 = pool (legacy AMM that consumes vault); DLMM = pool (active AMM); DAMM v2 = pool (active AMM); DBC = other (bonding curve launch); Presale Vault = vault; Alpha Vault = vault; Dynamic Fee Sharing = other; Zap = router; Stake2Earn = other (legacy); Farm = other (legacy); Mercurial Stable Swap = pool (legacy).

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] traced to fetched URLs: docs.meteora.ag/get-started/pushing-the-boundaries-of-defi and docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dynamic-vault. Solana program IDs are base58 strings and do not conform to the schema's 0x-prefixed EVM address format; they are recorded as-is in the role description field, with address field omitted where schema validation would fail.

rationale.verdict: Walked official Meteora docs (deployed-contracts page and vault developer guide) and GitHub vault-sdk repo; catalogued 12 Solana program IDs including the primary Dynamic Vault program and associated treasury/affiliate/constants. Audit PDFs were gated behind Google auth and could not be read. DeFiPunkd on-chain read API does not support Solana, so no on-chain state reads were possible. grade=unknown because no on-chain reads could confirm live deployment state.

protocol_metadata.about: Meteora Dynamic Vaults (formerly Mercurial Finance) is a yield aggregation layer on Solana that automatically distributes idle liquidity from AMM pools into external lending protocols such as Kamino, MarginFi, and Solend to earn additional yield. Users deposit supported tokens, receive vault LP tokens representing their share, and can withdraw by burning LP tokens; an off-chain keeper rebalances allocations every minute based on real-time APY across integrated platforms. The vault layer underpins Meteora's wider product suite — DLMM, DAMM v1/v2, and other programs — which routes idle pool capital through the vault to maximize LP returns. A 5% performance fee is minted as vault LP tokens when rebalancing reports profit and sent to a treasury address.
